subject: CS480
filterSummary: Successfully selected 9 out of 10 videos for the specified topics. The English selection provides strong coverage from well-known project management educators. The Arabic selection is also strong, drawing from academic lectures and popular PMP trainers. One topic, 'Approaches to Developing WBSs' in Arabic, had no sufficiently relevant candidates, as all available videos were general introductions to WBS rather than a comparison of development methodologies.

coverage.note: Most candidates focused on estimation techniques rather than WBS development approaches, failing the relevance gate.
No candidates specifically taught the different approaches (top-down, bottom-up); all were general introductions to WBS and failed the relevance gate.
Only one eligible candidate was found, which focuses on the WBS Dictionary component of the topic.
